title: Check the status of your online application – Births, Deaths and Marriages
summary: Check the progress of your online application for a birth, death, marriage, relationship registration, or change of name certificate.
intro: If you've applied online for a birth, death, marriage, relationship registration, or change of name certificate, you can also check how your application is progressing, online.
what_you_need: The email address used on your application form
The online reference number (ORN) provided when you applied

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to check the status of your application.

more_info.text: If you've misplaced your ORN, you can retrieve it by selecting 'Forgotten your ORN?', and then entering your name and email address.
